sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and verification

Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 of this section cites exactly one physical page, within physical pages twenty-nine to thirty-two, of the private snapshot of the Alabama Driver Manual edition dated on its front cover, the issuer's own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: facts restated from a single explicit page sentence are high confidence; nothing in this section was taken from memory or from a non-issuer source.
Precision rule: No-Zone lengths, truck and car stopping distances, no-parking distances, and child restraint ages and weights are kept exactly as printed, with the wording paraphrased so no learner line copies the manual.
Accuracy flags: none open; the No-Zone, hill-parking and parallel-parking pictures on physical pages twenty-nine to thirty-one extracted as captions only, so facts came from the body text and the printed captions, never from the drawings; the closing banner on physical page thirty-two prints a word that reads as a misprint before serious injuries, so the fact taken from it names serious injuries only.
Stability: the manual is one dated edition; any rule a later law or edition changes must be re-read from the current manual before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing and traffic rules for exam preparation only.

corpus_stability.reason: The Alabama Driver Manual is one dated edition (front cover, physical p1, prints November 2024); nothing on the selected pages indicates more than one rewrite per year.
